input.text: Concrete root graph finding (actual no-cloud probe saved as verification/T-005/root-graph-reference-probe.json): Expressions resolves resource Ref/GetAtt to plain strings such as @Workload. A literal alarm Dimensions.Value="@Workload" is accepted by validate_graph, although CloudFormation treats it as a literal dimension and it will not monitor the instance. Likewise literal backup Resources="arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:111111111111:instance/@Workload" passes. Both mutated graphs and baseline were accepted at source sha 4fe07bf60756fbab69703ac7854dc9a732eee149b5e461c737d5087916b9a047. Preserve the proof, add committed real failing regressions, and distinguish genuine symbolic references/compositions from attacker-written strings (typed tokens or another robust provenance-aware check). Cover Join/Sub construction as well, so a string marker restriction alone cannot be bypassed by concatenation. Keep the structural validator bounded and accept real independently authored valid CDK graphs.

scope: actual in-turn implementation finding, not independent gate
